decision: Do not promote bilateral rows or launch seed expansion for this version: forward benefit reverses in the preplanned reverse order. Incoming rows remain the stronger stable reference in this comparison.
interpretation: Independent old-row adjustment can improve one sequence, but extra degrees of freedom alone do not reliably improve merging. In reverse, both old12 and new4 final means are lower than baseline; do not attribute the aggregate failure exclusively to forgetting.
